entities.name: Dolores García-Hierro
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dolores "Lola" García-Hierro Caraballo is a Spanish politician. From 2011 to 2014, she served as a Member of the European Parliament, representing Spain for the Spanish Socialist Workers Party. She was also city councillor of Madrid, member of the Congress of Deputies as well as member of the Assembly of Madrid, and senator.
